newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel differentials steady in slow talk.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel differentials steady in slow talk.

text.p: European jet fuel differentials were notionally unchanged in slow discussion on Wednesday, traders said.
August IPE gas oil futures settled $2 higher at $164.75 a tonne, reflecting U.S. product strength.
Barges were talked around August IPE +$17, the same differential talked for cargoes in north-west Europe.

Supply remains meagre, with refiners continue to discuss whether the economics of the market make it worthwhile to run more product. Some argue differentials must firm before more supply comes to the market.
